C0715.title: New York Times Sues OpenAI Over Alleged Copyright Infringement in AI Training Data Scraping
C0715.summary: On December 27, 2023, The New York Times sued OpenAI and Microsoft in the Southern District of New York, alleging that they copied and used large volumes of copyrighted Times works without permission to train and operate generative AI products and could generate substitute text competing with Times content. The lawsuit became a representative case for copyright compliance risks in AI training data and generative AI outputs.
